observed: Long-running Codex executor, factual judge, semantic reviewer and planner paths use runReceipted with context.Background; a hung child can block the caller indefinitely. User observed a >1.5h apparent hang during AirGuard work.
expected: Caller wait is bounded; on wait expiry AirWorker returns RUNNING with receipt/output identity while durable child may continue; later poll resumes without duplicate model call.
evidence: air-worker--v0.11.3 cmd/runner_codex.go, judge.go, semantic.go, planner.go use context.Background with runReceipted
reproduction: Use a child command/model process that never returns through executor/judge/semantic path; caller has no timeout.
workaround: Manually inspect receipt/PID/output and stop only owned process if necessary.
proposed_outcome: Configurable per-role caller wait bound with durable RUNNING return and poll/resume semantics.
